mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Find repository objects by their name or a name pattern with wildcards.

description: [read-only] Searches the ABAP repository for the objects whose name matches query, a name or a mask. Required: query*. Optional: object_type, max_results (default 100). Response: one object per line. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_type.description: ADT object type to restrict the search to.

query.description: Object name or mask, with * as a wildcard.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

name: HandlerSearch
